dedupe_keys.name: glamour global building morphology dataset for urban hydroclimate modelling

description: GLAMOUR: GLobAl building MOrphology dataset for URban hydroclimate modelling is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Ruidong Li et al. Understanding building morphology helps simulate interactions between urban structures and hydroclimate dynamics. Despite significant efforts to generate detailed global building morphology datasets, there is a lack of practical solutions using publicly accessible resources. Coverage: global; published in 2024. Formats: GeoTIFF, Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
